name: What kind of drainage does artificial turf offer, especially in heavy rain?

mainEntity.name: What kind of drainage does artificial turf offer, especially in heavy rain?

acceptedAnswer.text: Modern artificial turf systems are designed with excellent drainage capabilities. The turf backing itself is typically permeable, allowing water to pass through to the prepared sub-base. Below the turf, a compacted aggregate base creates a stable, porous layer that facilitates water percolation into the soil beneath. Our installation process ensures proper grading of the sub-base to direct water effectively, preventing pooling and ensuring efficient runoff, even during occasional heavy rainfall events. This design helps prevent waterlogging and maintains a dry, usable surface.
acceptedAnswer.description: Artificial turf features permeable backing and a sloped, compacted aggregate base, ensuring excellent drainage and preventing water pooling, even in heavy rain.
